_comment: Memory placement debt register (issue #5391). One entry per memory that already scored at or above the flag threshold when the gate landed; a file below the threshold is not recorded, so it is gated by the plain threshold and the ratchet never turns an ordinary signal into a failure. Generated by check_memory_placement.py --update-baseline. A gate run with --baseline fails a recorded file only when its score rises above the value here. The register may only shrink: migration issues #5392, #5393, and #5394 clear it.
